item.title: Two American Airlines planes clip wings while taxiing at Washington airport
item.description: Two American Airlines planes clipped their wings while taxiing at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. The incident occurred around 5.10pm ET and led to an emergency response. Both aircraft returned to their gates for inspection, after which American Airlines arranged alternative travel for passengers. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Ariacna y Yamila llevan más de un mes viviendo con sus hijos en las calles de La Habana. Las dos jóvenes, de 35 y 19 años respectivamente, recorren la ciudad con sus pequeños en brazos. El menor de ellos tiene apenas un año. Sobreviven de las limosnas y duermen a la intemperie.Su historia fue recogida esta semana por el medio independiente 'Cubanet'. En una entrevista, ambas relataron las dificultades para alimentar a sus hijos y la imposibilidad de conseguir una vivienda. «Los niños están pasando hambre y necesidad. Las mujeres están casi vendiéndolo todo porque los niños no tienen nada que… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Indiana court reverses stepfather's adoption of girl, says mother restricted biological father's access
item.description: An Indiana stepfather’s adoption of his wife’s daughter has been reversed by an appeals court. The ruling found that the biological father's limited contact was largely a result of the mother's attempts to limit his access. Evidence indicated he sought involvement and provided financial support. The majority opinion pointed out discrepancies in the mother’s testimony compared to previous court decisions, leading to a remand for further custody deliberations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Supreme Court orders fresh review of Montana widow's inheritance dispute
item.description: Montana's Supreme Court has mandated that a lower court revisit the distribution of a deceased man's estate to his widow. This legal dispute arose following the death of Jack Raymond Stone, leading his wife Sara Benchoff Stone to file a claim. After Sara's passing, her son continued her pursuit, focusing on the property's valuation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: 2,200 shipping containers from Arizona border wall may become affordable rental homes in Tucson
item.description: Boxes of Hope has joined forces with La Frontera to transform steel shipping containers into affordable housing solutions. With a vision to establish between 350 and 450 rental units, the initiative will also provide essential services like behavioral healthcare and job training. Currently in the planning phase, with fundraising underway, the project aims to commence site development by 2027, addressing Tucson's growing affordable housing crisis as many await support. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Archaeologists digging in Alexandria's ancient royal quarter uncovered massive limestone
item.description: Archaeologists have unveiled an impressive limestone foundation in Alexandria that may belong to a royal tomb. The site, located in the ancient Royal Quarter, features a mysterious tunnel and a distinctive square structure. Experts believe this could be linked to Ptolemy IV Philopator and potentially serve a funerary purpose. A dedicated committee is examining the architectural details, while further excavations promise to illuminate Alexandria's fascinating historical narrative. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: La lucha contra la desnutrición infantil en las comunidades indígenas en Guatemala
item.description: Las infecciones respiratorias por inhalar el humo de las estufas y la diarrea por consumir agua contaminada con coliformes fecales son comunes en los hogares indígenas. Estas afecciones pueden llegar a ser mortales en niños menores de cinco años que sufren desnutrición crónica. Las brigadas de salud monitorean el estado nutricional de los niños de zonas rurales, cuya dieta suele basarse en tortillas de maíz y fríjoles. En Totonicapán, siete de cada diez niños presentan retraso en el crecimiento. Para combatir esta crisis, el Ministerio de Salud, junto con Unicef, apuesta por un suplemento… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Virginia worker wins disability benefits seven years after 20-foot construction fall
item.description: A Virginia appeals court upheld the temporary total disability benefits for construction worker Olegario Felipe Valles. The employer's appeal to terminate his benefits was rejected due to insufficient evidence. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

This area includes prime farmland, wetlands, and river shoreline along the Pamunkey River. This initiative highlights the importance of preserving historical and ecological landscapes for future generations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town after army chief's threat sparks row
item.description: Uganda's army on Friday said it planned to withdraw from the eastern DR Congo town of Lubero in North Kivu. The announcement came days after Ugandan army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba – son of President Yoweri Museveni – threatened to take control of Walikale, another North Kivu town, sparking a diplomatic spat between the two neighbouring nations. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Pennsylvania widow keeps $6,000 home after court rejects stepchildren's inheritance claim
item.description: Jane L. Shellhammer, a widow from Pennsylvania, has successfully defended her right to remain in her family home following her husband's passing. Although his children attempted to lay claim to the property, the Pennsylvania Superior Court determined that the couple owned the house as tenants by the entirety. Consequently, Jane retains sole ownership of the Palmerton residence, a place she has cherished for over 45 years. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Spanish Police Find a Vast Marijuana Bunker Beneath a Backyard Playground
item.description: Five people were arrested in southern Spain after a large marijuana farm was found under a playhouse on artificial turf. Fuente: The New York Times - World.

item.title: In 1947, architect John Lautner designed a Hollywood Hills home with a roof supported by a three-point steel structure; the preserved two-bedroom Polin House is now listed for $2.85 million
item.description: Renowned architect John Lautner's striking house from 1947 has hit the market, offering a distinctive two-bedroom, two-bathroom experience in the vibrant Hollywood Hills. Spanning 1,342 square feet and priced at $2,850,000, this home features a groundbreaking steel roof truss design that provides an uninterrupted interior space. With outdoor terraces enhancing the living area, this listing is a rare chance to own a piece of architectural history. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Google told to halt Belgium datacentre construction over lack of planning permit
item.description: Greenpeace publishes report showing tech firm is continuing to build despite planning appeal still unresolved Belgian authorities have ordered Google to halt construction work on a large datacentre in the south of the country because the US tech firm’s requests to modify the original terms of the planning permission did not have approval. “Inspectors visited the site and observed that the building was almost finished, with the structural work completed, even though the permit had been refused,” Raphaël Stokis, a Wallonia regional official, told the public broadcaster RTBF . item.description: Almost every European teenager is online. Some 96 percent of 15-year-olds use social media, yet many say they do not feel safe there. One in four children in the EU, aged 12 to 17, report having experienced cyberbullying, and nearly one in three say social media has left them feeling stressed, sad or socially excluded. item.description: Closely watched decision exposes tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights Canada’s top court has largely upheld a controversial secularism law in the province of Quebec barring public sector workers from wearing conspicuous religious symbols, in a closely watched decision that exposes the tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights. In a 6-1 ruling released on Friday morning , the supreme court found Quebec was permitted to shield the law, Bill 21, from most court challenges on the grounds that it violated… Publicado también por: The Guardian - World, Al Jazeera English. item.description: An EU leaders summit on the bloc's seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine. The budget proposal also includes a 3% tax on US tech companies, in a bid for the EU to generate additional funds. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: Jared Kushner’s 70-minute interview reveals perils of treating Putin like a corporate rival
item.description: Trump’s son-in-law and senior negotiator paints Russian invasion of Ukraine as a misunderstanding to be resolved In the space of a 70-minute interview, Jared Kushner – Donald Trump’s son-in-law and a prominent US negotiator in Russia, Gaza and Iran – probably did more to reveal why the world is mired in entrenched conflicts than a thousand geopolitical tomes or seminars. During the conversation this week with Mathias Döpfner, the chief executive of the Axel Springer media publisher, Kushner gave a rare insight into his diplomatic technique, offering a string of homilies that veered close to… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Agua del mar Rojo para Jordania: un plan de 6.700 millones de dólares
item.description: Jordania es uno de los países con menos agua del mundo y busca la solución en el mar Rojo. En Áqaba se construye una gran desalinizadora que costará 6.700 millones de dólares y que, desde 2030, debería cubrir el 40% del agua potable de uso doméstico del país. El agua tendrá que recorrer cientos de kilómetros hasta Amán. ¿Puede este proyecto resolver la crisis hídrica jordana y a qué coste? Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: More than 57,000 granted UK permanent residence via BN(O) route in year to September
item.description: More than 57,000 arrivals from Hong Kong became permanent residents in the United Kingdom in the 12 months to September 2026 under the bespoke BN(O) immigration pathway launched five years ago, with the city ranking second behind India in the number of UK settlement grants during the period. According to the UK Home Office, 57,040 people were granted permanent residence via the BN(O) route in the 12 months to September 30, 2026. This was up from just 637 BN(O) grants in the preceding 12 months... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: DR Congo: Copper reserves put Africa at the centre of the global race for critical minerals
item.description: Africa is emerging as a key player in the global race for copper, accounting for around 10 per cent of the world's estimated reserves. The Democratic Republic of Congo is at the centre of this growing interest, having mined 3.4 million metric tons of copper in 2025. Its vast mineral resources are attracting growing attention from countries and companies around the world, as demand for the metal rises due to its importance in energy infrastructure, electric vehicles and the global transition to cleaner energy. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: French student protests: A 'very bizarre' government response
item.description: “The government had a very bizarre way of dealing with the student protests,” says Jean-Rémi Girard, a secondary school teacher and union representative in Asnières-sur-Seine. He explains how teachers sought to defuse tensions by listening to students, and respecting their right to protest, while keeping classes running. He recounts a police intervention last October and the case of a student facing trial for defending a classmate, and has the full support of several teachers. Girard questions the government's heavy-handed policing and largely symbolic proposals on class sizes and university… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Centrica boss memo to 400 workers at gas plant off Yorkshire coast says utility doing all it can ‘to save your jobs’ The boss of the British Gas owner Centrica has told hundreds of staff at its largest gas storage facility that he was seeking urgent talks with Andy Burnham and would do everything he could to save jobs. Chris O’Shea, the chief executive of Centrica, reportedly told staff at the Rough gas storage facility off the east Yorkshire that the government had rebuffed the company’s plea for short-term support to run the store over the winter. item.title: León XIV, en su viaje de regreso a Roma: «El mensaje que yo quiero dar no es político. Aunque quieran forzarme a derecha e izquierda»
item.description: El Papa ha respondido pletórico a las preguntas de la prensa durante el vuelo de regreso de Perú . A lo largo de veinticinco minutos ha presumido entre bromas de su buena salud, ha ironizado sobre el rosario de un peregrino que le golpeó la cara en Lima y ha asegurado que no ha dejado escrita su renuncia para el caso de incapacidad . item.title: Back to Black Friday: 'We are now bombarded with offers throughout the year'
item.description: Black Friday was once a single day of holiday sales, held the day after Thanksgiving. Then retailers began kicking things off a day early, on Thanksgiving itself. “We are now bombarded with offers throughout the year,” says Hilary Ingham, Professor of Economics and Department Head at Lancaster University, who has no plans to shop this Black Friday. Ingham acknowledges a growing sense of “retail fatigue” but still sees the potential for a peak in sales. Meanwhile, an investigation by The Telegraph suggests that six in ten of the most popular products were actually more expensive than earlier… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Pollution from northern India and the wider region travels over the Bay of Bengal to Sri Lanka during the northeast monsoon, and crop burning is part of that mix Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong
item.description: The tiny Vallarta mud turtle was only discovered in 2018. It's critically endangered with around 300 thought to live in the wild. Almost one tenth of that number were stashed in a traveler's luggage, bound in duct tape. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: New Zealand Earthship built from 1,300 tyres and 7,000 bottles goes on sale after TV fame
item.description: For sale in New Zealand's scenic Coromandel region, a distinct four-bedroom Earthship home composed of recycled tyres and glass bottles awaits new owners. This eco-conscious abode, featuring solar power and passive heating, was constructed in 2015 and has gained popularity following its showcase on Grand Designs New Zealand. Owners Gus Anning and Sarah Rowe are transitioning to the Bay of Islands, seeking individuals who will honor their sustainable dream. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Directo París y los choques violentos entre hinchas del Marsella y el Levski Sofía
item.description: La victoria del Olympique de Marsella sobre Levski Sofía en la Europa League quedó opacada por graves incidentes entre aficionados en el estadio Vélodrome. Los enfrentamientos dejaron hinchas heridos e incluso hospitalizados, y han provocado una investigación de las autoridades francesas y la atención de la UEFA. Según testimonios y videos difundidos, la violencia estalló tras provocaciones entre grupos de hinchas, incluidas acusaciones de saludos nazis. El informe es de nuestra periodista Natalia Ruiz. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
